Align skill installer to @andreasnlarsen/whoop-cli@0.5.0 and document cross-platform secret storage for macOS, Linux/OpenClaw 1Password, and explicit local-vps setup
Adds structured experiment context fields (description/why/hypothesis/success criteria/protocol) and experiment context update command; pins installer to @andreasnlarsen/whoop-cli@0.3.1
Align installer to @andreasnlarsen/whoop-cli@0.3.0 and include profile-scoped experiment plan/status/report protocol with single-source state guidance
Activity-first command surface; remove workout commands; add agent-safe activity filtering guidance and pin installer to @andreasnlarsen/whoop-cli@0.2.0

Set clearer listing title emphasizing agent-first WHOOP CLI workflow.
